description: This file defines utility functions for parsing and unescaping SQL strings within Apache Spark's SQL Catalyst module, including handling of string literals, escape sequences, and source code position tracking.

classes.name: SparkParserUtils
classes.description: A trait providing utility methods for parsing SQL strings, handling escape sequences, and managing source code position metadata.

methods.name: unescapeSQLString
methods.description: Unescapes SQL string literals, supporting double-quote escaping, backslash escapes, Unicode escapes, and raw strings.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Retrieves the source code snippet corresponding to a parser rule context.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Converts a token or array of tokens into an unescaped string.

methods.name: stringIgnoreQuoteQuote
methods.description: Converts a token into a string, removing quote-quote sequences.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Gets the origin (line and position) of a token.

methods.name: withOrigin
methods.description: Sets the origin context for parsing, restoring previous state after execution.

methods.name: positionAndText
methods.description: Creates an Origin object with position and SQL text information, optionally applying position mapping.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Retrieves the command text that created the parser context.
